milestone: Native CPU nested immutable records through functions and workers

implementation.fields: Finite nominal record fields with numeric/Boolean leaves; forward declarations, chained reads and explicit nested with updates
implementation.validation: Shared iterative layout validation in source checking and native typed-IR capability checking; rejects cycles, invalid identities/storage flags and resource-budget violations before recursive target type construction
implementation.resource_budgets: Default semantic depth 128 record levels and maxValues 300000 expanded scalar leaves per layout; repeated child embeddings count separately, including previously completed dependency graphs
implementation.lowering: CPU MLIR and LLVM task emitter cache each record declaration target type; nested native structs preserve source nominal typing and existing aggregate output-pointer bridge
implementation.lifetime: Pointer-free value copies through ordinary helpers, imported inferred values, nested tasks, repeated awaits, group exits and TaskError recovery; no new record backing-storage ownership mechanism

contract.identity: Every nested field retains its original record declaration identity; identical physical layouts do not authorize substitution
contract.updates: Base first and replacements in written order; updating one shared child value does not mutate the other field or original record
contract.scope: CPU finite inline records. Collection fields, record callback captures/arrays, recursive managed structures, type exports, record display and GPU records remain separate gates. Native distributed execution still requires discussion.

scope: Debug and ASan/UBSan frontend tests cover six numeric families, three record levels, nested immutable updates, forward declarations, ordinary helpers/maps/conditionals and worker kernel metadata

Direct/indirect cycles including unused declarations, field-source diagnostics, cached dependency height, repeated-child expanded leaf budgets, default depth and DAG size limits, and ten malformed nested-IR mutations
Trusted task harness reused for flat and nested records; nested payload has three record levels, mixed bool/int32/uint64 metadata, numeric x/y fields and padding-sensitive C++/LLVM layout checks

64 raw-bit cases per numeric family at 1/2/4 workers, source packet overwrite/context settlement before execution, nested workers and toggled/restored nested updates, repeated observations, canaries, wrong-layout rejection and value survival after scheduler destruction

Pre-dispatch cancellation/deadline, bounded admission rejection and task allocation-failure positions 1-16 at 1/4 workers, with settled scheduler/owner ledgers and no payload allocation on observation

Generated source programs cover mixed-width/bool-only nested records, unchanged originals and shared children, record recovery/rethrow/matching, conditional paths, nested callback helpers, numeric array/tensor integration and imported nested results/updates
Written initializer order and base-before-replacement order verified through distinguishable checked Bounds/Arithmetic faults; failed workers produce no partial stdout
Invalid cyclic source preserves preexisting executable/LLVM/MLIR outputs

Prior flat record/worker/collection/module/numeric/control frontends and executions, source/task recovery/storage/continuations and selected Metal regressions; focused qualification, not full-suite coverage

remaining_gates: Collection fields and recursive ownership qualification
Whole-record callback captures and record arrays
Type exports and broader native values/package composition
